# .github Repository Configuration

# This file contains recommended GitHub repository settings and metadata.

# Repository Metadata
name: AI Chat

description: >-
  AI Chat is a full-stack, containerized chat application powered by AI, featuring a Spring Boot backend and Angular frontend, with support for authentication, user management, and internationalization.

# Topics/Keywords
# Add these as repository topics on GitHub for discoverability
# (You can add them via the GitHub UI or API)
topics:
  - ai
  - chat
  - spring-boot
  - angular
  - fullstack
  - docker
  - internationalization
  - authentication
  - user-management
  - signals
  - monorepo
  - postgres
  - gradle
  - typescript
  - java
  - admin

# Recommended Branch Protection Rules
# (Configure via GitHub UI or API)
# - Require pull request reviews before merging
# - Require status checks to pass before merging
# - Require linear history
# - Require signed commits

# Issue Templates
# Place markdown files in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/

# Pull Request Template
# Place a markdown file at .github/pull_request_template.md

# Actions/Workflows
# Place workflow YAML files in .github/workflows/

# Code Owners
# Place a CODEOWNERS file in .github/

# Funding
# Place a FUNDING.yml file in .github/

# Security Policy
# Place a SECURITY.md file in .github/

# Contributing Guidelines
# Place a CONTRIBUTING.md file in .github/

# License
# Place a LICENSE file in the root directory

# Contact
# Set up repository contact links via GitHub settings

# For more details, see: https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-repository-settings
